verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms New Relic serves an llms.txt at docs.newrelic.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It describes itself as documentation for the observability platform and points to clean markdown versions of the docs, which an agent can be directed to. Several cited doc URLs are .md pages, which fits that description. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explaining agent-oriented doc usage and scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming the llms.txt and markdown docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Documentation for New Relic's observability platform.
